test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which edition of 'Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana' has been announced in union budget 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4th Edition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** is a flagship scheme launched by the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)** to provide short-term skill development training and certification to youth.
 
• The scheme has been implemented in multiple phases since its inception in **2015**. The latest iteration, the **4th Edition**, was announced in the **Union Budget 2023**.
 
• The **4th Edition of PMKVY** aims to focus on emerging technologies such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI), drone technology, Industry 4.0, and coding**, aligning with the evolving industry demand.
 
• PMKVY's objective is to bridge the skill gap in India and promote **self-employment and entrepreneurship**, thereby contributing to the country’s economic growth.
 
• This edition places a strong emphasis on the skilling of youth in rural and semi-urban areas, targeting **new-age skills** required for global competitiveness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) Overview:**

 
 
• Launched on **15 July 2015**, PMKVY was introduced as a part of the Skill India Mission.
 
• The scheme provides **free short-term training** to individuals, followed by skill certification to enhance employability.
 
• It targets individuals aged **18–35 years**, with a focus on school dropouts and the unemployed.
 
• PMKVY is implemented by **National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)**, in collaboration with state governments and industry partners.
 
 
 
• **Previous Editions of PMKVY:**
 
 
• The 1st Edition (PMKVY 1.0) ran from **2015–2016**, focusing primarily on skill certifications.
 
• PMKVY 2.0 (2016–2020) added features like **Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)** and district-level monitoring.
 
• PMKVY 3.0 (2021–2022) emphasized **industry-relevant skills** and technology-driven learning.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development in Emerging Technologies:**
 
 
• Under PMKVY's 4th Edition, training programs are tailored to global trends in **AI, robotics, blockchain, drones, and Industry 4.0**.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's vision of becoming a leader in **advanced technology sectors**.
 
 
 
• **Significance in Rural Development:**
 
 
• The 4th Edition emphasizes skill development in **rural and semi-urban areas**, improving employment opportunities for marginalized populations.
 
• It supports the government's focus on **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-Reliant India) by promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Emerging Skill Areas:** PMKVY 4.0 addresses **green jobs** like renewable energy, waste management, and sustainable construction, contributing to eco-friendly economic growth.
 
• **Collaboration with Industry:** Partnerships with **private companies** and international organizations enhance the quality and relevance of training programs.
 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation:** Advanced tracking mechanisms ensure transparency and effectiveness in program implementation.
 
• **Women Empowerment:** PMKVY promotes **female participation** in skill development programs, enhancing gender equality in the workforce.
